direction: Actual PvZ identities redrawn in approved rich pixel style; preserve sources and normalize only during import.

layout.plant: 5 x 3: idle2 walk4 attack3 hurt1 knockedOut2 cheer2 sleep1
layout.zombie: 5 x 3: idle2 walk4 attack3 hurt1 fall3; last two cells blank

actual_four_prompts.desc: Zombot Dark Dragon from PvZ2 Dark Ages. Long horizontal olive gray-green segmented armored mechanical dragon/serpent, huge bulging yellow reptile eyes, long toothy snout with prominent angular silver nose ring, sharp horns and jagged cheek fins, conical dorsal spikes. Body trails left behind head facing RIGHT; coiled tail can compress into square cell. Dr Zomboss sits behind the head wearing ornate golden knight helmet with tall red plume, gold armor and red cape. NOT a purple winged dragon, no heart tail, no round friendly baby. Match elongated threatening engineering silhouette of game. Windup raises snout, attack jaws gape, recovery lowers; defeated coils slump with yellow eyes dimming.

Zombot Tomorrow-tron from PvZ2 Far Future. Olive gray-green riveted rounded pod with a single enormous round yellow eye on FRONT facing RIGHT and a row of triangular steel teeth beneath. Orange-red horizontal trim and orange leg joint housings. SIX articulated insect/spider legs with long pointed steel feet, not humanoid arms or boots. Upper pinkish saucer rim supports a large cyan transparent cockpit dome. Inside is actual Dr Zomboss: wrinkled huge tan-green cranium, green face, white scientist coat and orange control sticks. No exposed pink brain, no white astronaut suit, no arm cannon, no antennae. Windup braces legs, attack eye and jaws thrust forward with legs extended, hurt recoils; defeat spider legs fold under pod, yellow eye dims, dome remains recognizable.

Zombot War Wagon from PvZ2 Wild West. Tall rectangular dark wooden riveted machine with ONE ENORMOUS yellow eyeball protruding from its FRONT facing RIGHT, surrounded by a rough timber frame and a gold angular bumper jaw. Four big black spoked wheels mounted on articulated wooden/metal struts like walking legs. Open railed roof deck: Dr Zomboss with huge wrinkled cranium, white lab coat, holding controls. A large brown zombie bull with curved white horns stands at REAR behind roof pilot, facing RIGHT. Match this strange tall walking wagon silhouette. NO canvas covered wagon, no cowboy hat, no sheriff star or flame decals. Windup struts rise, attack wagon charges forward with bull braced, recovery lowers, hurt eye squints; defeated struts buckle, bull sits safely on rear, eye dims.

Zombot Aerostatic Gondola from PvZ2 Lost City. Main identity is ornate compact wooden flying ship with a huge shiny GOLDEN SKULL figurehead at FRONT facing RIGHT, hanging green vines from skull jaw. Brown wood hull gold rails, cream cloth sandbags hanging on side, one blue patched sack, big circular black/gold side propellers and a small cream batwing tail at REAR. Dr Zomboss pilots open deck wearing brown leather aviator cap with large gold goggles, white fur collar, brown coat. Tall thin support ropes rise to cropped upper rigging with dark purple ribbed burner assembly centered above deck. Represent complete compact flight rig without an enormous cartoon balloon dominating the sprite; actual visible game boss is ship and skull. No eyes painted on balloon, no striped turquoise balloon, no simple basket. No exposed pink brain. Attack tilts golden skull downward and releases hanging sacks only within attached silhouette (no detached projectiles). Defeated rig slackens, ship settles low, pilot slumps; preserve all main parts.

remaining_actual_boss_prompts.desc: Zombot Plank Walker: tall round wooden PIRATE SHIP hull, giant SINGLE yellow eye set in bow facing RIGHT, side cannons in dark metal squares, tall mast with torn cream sail and small crow's nest. FOUR articulated wooden walking legs end in enormous black anchor-shaped hooked feet. Dr Zomboss wears black eyepatch at wheel on upper deck. A small regular pirate zombie with gold hoop earring is tied upright by thick ropes to bowsprit just above eyeball. Accurate weird walking ship proportions, no googly pair of hull eyes, no tiny toy pirate. Cannon attack poses brace legs and rock hull, no separate cannonballs. Defeat legs fold and hull sags, sail droops.

Zombot Tuskmaster 10,000 BC mapped to our Frost Mammoth boss. Actual game's floating huge mammoth head machine: shaggy dark reddish BROWN fur, sweeping cream ivory tusks bound by rope, long articulated raised curling TRUNK facing RIGHT, angry yellow eyes with reddish pupils, green mechanical tusk mount plates. Tall fur-framed curved glass cockpit on back holds Dr Zomboss in white coat. Silver gray mechanical underside with short cyan energy glide segments close under body, no legs, no large detached lightning effects. NOT a blue robot elephant and no rounded baby body. Windup trunk curls, attack trunk thrusts and tusks lift, hurt curls back; defeat trunk drops and cockpit slumps over fur while remaining machine recognizable.

Zombot Sharktronic Sub: huge SILVER steel shark head submarine facing RIGHT, tall angular triangular nose and fins, broad exposed yellow eye with tiny black pupil, bolted overlapping metal plates, gigantic hinged mouth lined with long triangular steel teeth and dark burgundy inner mouth. Small rounded glass dome behind head on upper back contains green Dr Zomboss with massive veined cranium and white coat at controls. Compact rear fin. Much of silhouette is big angular jaw, no humanoid limbs, no blue cute fish, no goggles on shark. Windup jaw lowers, strike very wide open snapping jaw, recovery half closed; defeated jaw sags onto base, eye dimmed, pilot slumps.

Zombot Dinotronic Mechasaur: actual game long segmented SILVER and pale lavender metallic Tyrannosaurus head and neck machine, HUGE squared hinged steel jaw with chunky rectangular teeth, prominent bulging yellow eye, rivets and flat rectangular metal plates, pointed polygonal upper skull crest. Segmented thick neck curves back LEFT to fit into square while head faces RIGHT, not a little full-body dinosaur on feet. Small transparent dome over top behind eye contains Dr Zomboss in white lab coat with huge veined cranium. Match mechanical puppet-like rigid segments. Windup upper head rises, strike huge jaw opens, recovery closes; defeat hinges and neck slump into low pile but preserve head silhouette.

Zombot Multi-stage Masher in its actual Neon Mixtape Tour PUNK concert stage form. Mobile angular gray stage platform with magenta neon edge trim and enormous tall black loudspeaker stacks across BACK LEFT, plus big teal bass drum, teal tom drums and brass cymbals on central raised platform. Dr Zomboss at front RIGHT has tall red-and-lime punk mohawk, veined large cranium and black punk vest with bright studs, gripping microphone. Two smaller shaggy brown-haired zombie bandmates in turquoise jackets/red shirts play purple electric guitar and keytar at rear/front left. Stage faces RIGHT, enough three-quarter depth to see deck. This is a mobile concert-stage boss, NOT humanoid robot or boombox with face. Attack musicians lean and swing instruments and speaker cones pulse physically; defeat stack slumps slightly, musicians slump safely, stage neon dims. No detached notes or floating effects.

plant_peashooter_actual_prompts.desc: Stage 0 BASIC PEASHOOTER: exactly the canonical bright lime green simple bulbous pea head and one thin backward curled leaf on rear of head. Friendly black oval eyes, wide flared single tube facing RIGHT. Small thin curved stem, four broad green basal leaves. Make this iconic recognizable Peashooter rather than generic green toy. No helmet, no fangs, no bow tie.

Stage 1 REPEATER: canonical original Repeater, NOT two barrels or two heads. One lime pea head with ONE broad single trumpet muzzle, four pointed swept-back rear head leaves and determined slanted leafy eyebrows. Same thin curved stem and four broad base leaves. Slightly broader/stronger than basic Peashooter, but no thick human neck. No helmet or costume. Eyes retain black oval game appearance.

Stage 2 GATLING PEA: canonical original Gatling Pea with olive military helmet and chinstrap, black rectangular cheek facepaint, FOUR short dark steel barrels clustered in a diamond at the single muzzle facing RIGHT, pale metallic rims and black bores. Exactly FOUR barrels visible, not a giant long gun and not ordinary single tube. Large green head, thin curved green stem and broad base leaves, determined black oval eyes. Helmet stays attached in every frame including KO, root leaves never turn into feet. Each attack release may rotate the barrel cluster a little while preserving four barrels.

chomper_wallnut_actual_prompts.desc: Canonical CHOMPER: large rounded purple spotted head with ENORMOUS hinged open jaw, vivid green continuous lip rim, irregular triangular ivory teeth, pink tongue, a few pale sage conical spikes down crown, curved PURPLE stem and broad GREEN leaf base and rear neck leaf frill. Absolutely NO EYES or eyebrows anywhere, not even closed eyes in sleep or hurt. Express through jaw, tongue, head tilt and leaf posture. One head only. Idle mouth partly open in characteristic hungry grin. Walk stalk bends and base leaves slide, attack windup jaw opens wide, strike clamps down, recovery tongue returns. Hurt jaw jolts; KO head rests sideward low with slack jaw; cheer mouth opens high with tongue curl; sleep jaw closed and head droops without adding eyelids. Identity matches actual game, no baby dinosaur.

SUPER CHOMPER, an evolved stage based on canonical eyeless Chomper. Same purple round spotted toothy head with bright GREEN lip rim, curved purple stem, broad green root leaves and green rear leaf frill; make head broader, jaws stronger, ivory teeth larger and crown sage spikes more pronounced than basic Chomper. One head, NO EYES or eyebrows anywhere in any frame, even asleep or hurt. Larger secondary leaf collar. No metal armor or body legs. Actions: mouth idle partly open, walking stalk flex and root scoot, attack jaw opens wide then powerful clamp then recovery, hurt jaw jolts, KO head low on leaves with slack jaw, cheer high open jaw with curled pink tongue, sleep jaw rests closed without eyelids.

MEGA CHOMPER, final evolved stage of canonical Chomper: impressively HUGE purple spotted jaw/head with vivid GREEN continuous lip rim, large irregular ivory triangular teeth, thick pink tongue, taller pale sage crown spikes, lush green neck leaf frill and large broad green root leaves supporting thicker curved PURPLE stem. Single head, absolutely NO EYES, eyebrows, face stickers, arms or legs. Keep canonical carnivorous plant silhouette, exaggerate jaw scale and leafy frill naturally, no dragon body. Wide hungry idle grin. Root scoot walk. Attack jaw opens enormous then snaps closed then loosens; hurt head recoils; KO head low on leaves with slack jaw; cheer jaw raised and tongue curled; sleep closed jaw curled onto leaves, no eyelids added.

WALL-NUT: canonical simple golden-brown lumpy oval WALNUT shell with rich ridged vertical side seam and irregular woody shell texture; two large off-white round slightly mismatched googly eyes with tiny dark pupils. Preserve our project's mouthless family rule: NO MOUTH at all, no nose, no eyebrows. Body itself is the nut with flat rounded bottom, no green leaves, no arms or feet. Actual game shell anatomy, no generic smooth emoji ball. Idle tiny squash/breathe; walk 4 distinct whole-body waddling hops and tilts with rounded base; attack squash windup, lean/ram RIGHT, recover; hurt eyes scrunch; KO nut tilts and rests on side with closed eyes but no broken debris; cheer happy eye arcs and bouncy tall stretch; sleep eyes closed body settled. All15frames same shell.

TALL-NUT: actual game tall blocky rounded-rectangle golden-brown nut shell, wider flat crown, ridged ragged vertical shell seam, woody faceted texture; two heavy-lidded off-white eyes with tiny dark pupils, steadfast serious gaze. Keep project mouthless family rule: NO MOUTH or nose. No added band, armor, leaves, arms or feet at this stage. Body itself is shell with broad flat bottom. Tall strong vertical silhouette, clearly taller than Wall-nut. Idle subtle squish, walk 4 whole-body waddling tilts, attack squash/bracing then lean/ram RIGHT then restore, hurt recoil squint, KO 2 frames tilting and settled on side with closed eyes, cheer eye arcs/body stretch, sleep closed eyes settled. Keep shell attached, no debris.

GIGA TALL-NUT, project's evolved extension of actual Tall-nut. Very tall broad rounded-rectangle golden-brown walnut shell with irregular woody texture, ragged side seam and flat rounded crown, two large heavy-lidded off-white eyes with tiny pupils. NO MOUTH or nose. Add one restrained riveted gunmetal reinforcement band around LOWER body below eyes to communicate final-stage defense, leaving most real walnut shell visible. No helmet/crown, shield, arms, legs, leaves or feet. Larger sturdier natural Tall-nut silhouette, not a robot. Idle squish; four whole-body waddling tilts; attack brace compression then strong lean/ram RIGHT then recover; hurt recoil; KO2tilting and resting on side with closed eyes (band stays); cheer eye arcs and proud tall stretch; sleep closed eyes settled.
